title: Leandro shows visitors the wrong cave for money

tellings.quote: My theory is he's been showing people this cave to make money. He charges about 3 grand

plain: A local man named Leandro, a key witness to the small three-fingered mummies said to come from caves in the Nazca region of Peru, may be showing visitors the wrong cave to make money. That is the theory of Michael Mazzola, a guest who went to Peru and met him, and who says Leandro charges about 3,000 dollars for the trip. If he is right, the place where the bodies were really found would still be unknown.
